## Problem

What user workflow or limitation should change?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest behavior that would solve the problem. Include the RDP
client and macOS versions involved.

## Validation

Explain how the behavior could be measured or tested. A manual Windows
`mstsc` procedure is useful when an automated loopback test cannot cover it.
